jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager - Nuclear
jobs.description:
Requisition ID:
99755

Job Category:
Energy

Location:
Houston, TX, United States

Join a company that is passionately committed to the pursuit of a better world through positive change. With more than 70 years of business and technical expertise in mining , energy , and infrastructure , our 10,000 colleagues in 150 countries tirelessly work toward bettering the industries in which we operate. With practical solutions that are safe, innovative and sustainable, we think globally while acting locally. Are you looking for an opportunity to join a diverse group of professionals who are committed to remaining exceptional? We look forward to hearing from you.

Our energy expertise in the oil and gas sector comprises the entire value chain - upstream, midstream, and downstream; and in the power sector includes thermal, nuclear, waterpower, renewable, hybrid, transmission and distribution, and grid modernization. Join our vision of a low-carbon world and help make positive change!

Senior Nuclear Engineering Manager

This is a technical and business development position within the Power Business Unit of Hatch. It provides an opportunity for professional growth to the selected individual within the nuclear power group by engaging in business development and project execution for studies, detailed design and owner’s engineering work for our clients.

The successful candidate will work as part of the Power team and work within the Nuclear Sub-BU in multi-disciplinary teams to undertake/complete assignments flawlessly. Technical knowledge, project management, client engagement, business development, proposal management, and Project Management are core responsibilities. Reporting to the Global Director, Nuclear, and working closely with others in the Nuclear group and the rest of Hatch to ensure that all projects are completed in accordance with applicable codes and standards, Hatch’s corporate policies and processes and to the full satisfaction of clients.

Role & Responsibilities

Plan, execute and deliver high quality engineering and technical consulting services for nuclear power projects
Manage assigned studies and projects for clients including interfacing and reporting to clients, monitoring and managing budget and schedules for nuclear power projects or studies;
Provide mentorship to junior staff on specialized nuclear technical design and the nuclear engineering design process
Provide support to other regions in the development and delivery of projects within Hatch;
Review and approve technical deliverables
Support business development efforts and strategic initiatives, including preparation of proposals, pursuit plans for the nuclear Sub-BU;
Manage the proposal process for RFPs, EOIs, RFQs, and other formats
Adhere to and promote the Hatch culture.

Qualifications

Engineering degree from a recognized college
Minimum of 15 years of progressive experience within the nuclear power industry
Experienced working in a consulting engineering environment
Experience with light water reactors and advanced reactor designs
Ability to manage and motivate individuals to attain quality of deliverables , cost and schedule objectives
Strong deliverable focus, ability to plan the work
Broad knowledge of codes and standards for the nuclear industry
A high degree of understanding of inter-discipline dependencies
Able to prepare, read, and analyze engineering documents (P&IDs, PFDs, SLDs, plot plans, etc.)
Proven track record in business development, development and maintenance of client relations;
Flexibility for short term business travels
Ability to communicate effectively and professionally with all levels of staff and clients (both written and orally);
Ability to plan and write comprehensive project reports
Track record of delivering projects on time and to budget;
Demonstrated leadership capabilities and experience within organizations and teams, people manager
Experience in engineering, procurement and construction, and other project-related activities, their interfaces and interdependencies.

Competencies (knowledge, Skill, Attributes)

Strong understanding of engineering and business fundamentals as they apply to engineering problems and projects
Ability to learn quickly and to take on new challenges
Collaborative team player with excellent interpersonal skills
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Shows critical and creative thinking and problem solving, and brings forward solutions for our clients' toughest challenges
Adapts and embraces change

Why join us?

Work with great people to make a difference
Collaborate on exciting projects to develop innovative solutions
Top employer

What we offer you?

Flexible work environment
Long term career development
Think globally, work locally

Don't meet every single requirement? You don't need to. At Hatch, we are building a diverse, inclusive workplace that fosters innovation. If you're interested in this role, we encourage you to apply even if your past experiences don't perfectly align with the skills we've listed.

We're committed to fostering a workforce that reflects the diversity of the communities in which we operate and serve. Hatch is an Equal Opportunity Employer that considers applicants without regard to age, race, color, national origin, citizenship, religion, creed, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, veteran, or any other protected status. If you have any accommodation requirements, please let us know. We'll do our best to meet your needs in accordance with applicable local legislation.
